assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq v2, HiSeq 2500 single-end, salmon v1.1.0, GRCm38) of gastrocnemius muscle (S3.6.p1, FIG1)
samples: WT, PGC-1a mKO and PGC-1a mTG male mice at 3 mo and 24 mo; n = 6 per group except mKO 3 mo n = 5 (FIG1 legend)
primary_estimand: For GSE233485: age (24 vs 3 mo) and PGC-1a loss/gain-of-function effects on muscle transcription (S1.1.p1). The paper's exercise evidence is NOT in this series: exercise effects come from proteomics (wheel-running cohorts from ref 21, FIG4C; treadmill-trained vs sedentary 25 mo mice, TMT16plex, MassIVE MSV000092099, FIG4D, S3.15) and the RNA-seq is used only to show that mTG mimics the exercise pattern in the sedentary state (S1.4.p1, SI Fig S3H).
planned_contrasts: WT 24 mo vs WT 3 mo (aging; S1.1.p1, FIG1E FDR<0.05 markers; no DEG count reported)
mKO vs WT and mTG vs WT within age (PGC-1a dependence; S1.1.p1)
No exercise contrast exists in GSE233485 (exercise = proteomics, FIG4C/D, S3.2, S3.15, DA.p1)
paper_method: edgeR on the count matrix, genes with >= 1 CPM in all 5-6 replicates (S3.7.p1; GEO data_processing); PCA/z-score clustering on log2 TPM (S3.8.p1)
paper_results: 860 genes aligned with PC1/PC2; cluster 1 of mitochondrial genes; top GO terms include translation (S1.1.p1). No exercise DEG list from RNA-seq.
